selection: Classify each bounded work item by consequence and uncertainty, not prompt length. Important overrides light when both apply. Return to Sol when the important decision is resolved.
execution: Use the exposed native model/reasoning controls for an authorized delegation. If the host only lets the user change the coordinator model, report the required model selection instead of claiming to switch it. Preserve the current owner session, sandbox, task authority and budgets.
unavailable: Do not silently substitute Sol for required Astra work. Report model unavailability and continue only independent light work. Never bypass permissions, add a gateway, or launch another owner session.
claude: This OpenAI-model policy applies to Codex. Claude-native agents inherit the selected Claude model unless the user separately configures a supported provider/model mapping. Do not put OpenAI model IDs into Claude agent frontmatter.
